programme.title: Body Double
programme.desc: 1984. Thriller. Directed by Brian De Palma. Stars Craig Wasson & Melanie Griffith. A struggling actor's obsession with spying on a neighbour gets him caught up in a drastic series of events.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
programme.desc: 1960. Horror. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Laurence Payne, Adrienne Corri & Dermot Walsh. A man is tortured by the sound of his friend's beating heart after killing him in a jealous rage.

programme.title: White Cargo
programme.desc: 1973. Comedy. Day-dreamer, Albert (David Jason) has hopes of being a superhero and saving the girls.

programme.title: The Wedding Of Lilli Marlene
programme.desc: 1953. War Time Drama. Lilli will not marry her love, an American reporter, until she becomes a star. Starring Lisa Daniely, Hugh McDermott and Sid James.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Raffertys. Directed by Aaron Spelling. A bounty hunter is on the trail of Rafferty because of an outstanding arrest warrant, Ringo tries to find him first to convince him to turn himself in.

programme.title: Blind Date
programme.desc: 1959. Thriller. Directed by Joseph Losey. Starring Hardy Kruger, Stanley Baker & Micheline Presle. The mistress of a struggling artist is killed and Inspector Morgan investigates a complex case.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout December.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Iron Ponds/Lobster Breeding. 1986. Jack Hargreaves fishes one of the hundreds of little ponds of Kent, relics of the iron age. He then visits a lobster research station.

programme.title: Bombay Waterfront
programme.desc: 1952. Directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley, Patricia Dainton and Peter Gawthorne. Follows Temple's efforts to aid the police in solving a series of gruesome murders.

programme.title: Look At Life Drummers of the Queen
programme.desc: 1964. A spotlight is put on the Junior Guardsmen's Company, which teaches drumming among other trades.

programme.title: Flockton Flyer
programme.desc: I Name This Ship. 1977. Stars Gwyneth Strong, Peter Duncan & Annabelle Lanyon. The grand opening of the restored Flockton to Lane End Railway. (S1, E06).

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole at Sea. Stars: Leo McKern, Marion Mathie, Robin Bailey. While on a Mediterranean cruise, Rumpole is confronted with his old nemesis.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Rip Off. 1977. Stars Brian Grellis & Norman Rossington. Bowker & Jack Crawford's relationship is simple; one way or another Bowker's going to nail Crawford, unless Crawford can nail Bowker first.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: 1957. Western. Director: Allan Dwan. Stars Scott Brady, Anne Bancroft, Jay C. Flippen. A young lawyer travels to Mission, a small Texas border town, to even the score for the murder of his father.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: American baritone singer Lou Rawls performs the soulful hit Three O'Clock in the Morning.

programme.title: Blind Corner
programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars William Sylvester, Barbara Shelley & Elizabeth Shepherd. The wife of a blind composer plots to murder her husband after he learns of her affair.

programme.title: The Man In The Iron Mask
programme.desc: 1977. Adventure. Director: Mike Newell. Stars Richard Chamberlain & Patrick McGoohan. D'Artagnan and the musketeers plot to replace the hated King Louis XIV with his imprisoned twin brother.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Deception. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Marjorie Stewart & Ann Stephens. Only two out of the three Hadley sisters have suitors. The older sister makes up a romance and ends up getting blackmailed.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Noel and Mike are joined by a familiar face from the antiques world, Eric Knowles! Watch a brilliant scopitone by The Kessler Sisters, and the Hornchurch Bus Garage cricket team needs your help!

programme.title: The Racing Game
programme.desc: Odds Against. 1979. Stars Mike Gwilym, Mick Ford & James Maxwell. Champion steeplechase jockey Sid Halley investigates some strange accidents of Seabury racecourse and soon uncovers an inside man.

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: How to Retire without Really Working. Stars John Gregson Alexander Davion and Daphne Anderson. A middle-age couple commit a small time crime once a month and live off the swag.

programme.title: The Case of Marcel Duchamp
programme.desc: 1984. Drama. Director: David Rowan. Stars Guy Rolfe, Raymond Francis & Juliet Hammond. Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson exit retirement to solve a case concerning the artist, Marcel Duchamp.

programme.title: A Good Read with Mike Read
programme.desc: The Ides of March - Part 1. Mike Read reads classic Raffles stories from The Amateur Cracksman by E.W. Hornung and begins with the exciting tale The Ides of March.

programme.title: Twilight's Last Gleaming
